ModelInstallState.description:
Represent where a local generation model is in its install lifecycle (ADR 0011).

A model with no stored row is `not_installed`. `installed` means the verified files are present
but generation is off; `enabled` means generation may use them. The transitions allowed between
these values are defined in `services/model_manager.py`.

OutputMode.description:
Describe the project type: the purpose of the recording and the package built for it.

The API keeps the historical field name `mode` (ADR 0009). Version 0.2 stored
`technical_walkthrough`; migration 20261029_0003 rewrites it to `task_briefing`.

ProcessStart.description:
Validate the optional choices sent when processing starts (P05.4).

`mode` sets the project type and is required when the project has none; `source_language`
replaces the spoken language and `glossary` the project's terms. All are stored atomically
with the queued state.

RecordingCaptureResponse.description:
Capture settings the recorder applies to its `MediaRecorder` instances (P05.3).

`chunkSeconds` is the `MediaRecorder` timeslice, `videoBitsPerSecond` the screen track's video
bitrate and `maxFrameRate` the highest frame rate requested from the screen capture.
RecordingCaptureResponse.title: RecordingCaptureResponse

RecordingChunkResponse.description: Acknowledge one durably stored chunk; `duplicate` is true for a repeated identical upload.
RecordingChunkResponse.title: RecordingChunkResponse

RecordingComplete.description:
Validate the optional input of a recording's completion into the project source video.

`name` replaces the project name when sent (the recorder's Save dialog). `stopAtGap` keeps
each track only up to its first missing chunk, for an interrupted recording whose missing
chunks can no longer be uploaded; without it a missing chunk refuses the completion.
RecordingComplete.title: RecordingComplete

RecordingCreate.description:
Validate the optional metadata of a new recording session and its project.

The recorder sends the name in the interface language and local time (ADR 0015); without it
the API names the project `Recording {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM}` in the server's local time.
RecordingCreate.title: RecordingCreate

RecordingResponse.description: Expose the state, per-track storage and capture settings of one recording session.
RecordingResponse.title: RecordingResponse

RecordingState.description:
Represent the lifecycle of an in-app recording session (ADR 0010).

`recording` accepts chunks; `completed` is set once the chunks became the project source video
(P05.2). A discarded session is deleted together with its project, so it has no state.
RecordingState.title: RecordingState

RecordingTrack.description: Name the two independently uploaded tracks of a recording session.
RecordingTrack.title: RecordingTrack

RecordingTrackResponse.description:
Report what is stored for one track so an interrupted recorder can resume its uploads.

`nextSequence` is one past the highest stored sequence (0 when none is stored).
`missingSequences` lists, in ascending order and at most 100 at a time, the sequences below
it that are not stored; `missingCount` is their full number.
RecordingTrackResponse.title: RecordingTrackResponse

`reviewedText` may be an intentional empty value. `speakerLabel` set to null clears the
label; leaving the field out keeps it. At least one of the two fields must be sent.

Name who speaks in a transcript segment of an in-app recording (P05.5, I-03).

`you` is the person at the microphone, `others` everyone heard through the system audio.
A segment without a label stores NULL.

info.title: Narrastep API

get.description: Return one export progress record for direct polling clients.
Download a completed immutable ZIP while rejecting partial or missing artifacts.
Verify that the API process and authoritative SQLite store are available.
Return the latest authoritative processing snapshot for polling clients.

post.description: Persist cooperative cancellation and revoke work that has not started yet.

get.description: Stream database-resynchronized progress with event IDs and bounded heartbeats.

List the pinned generation models with their state, progress and license.

`localGeneration` is `disabled` when the kill switch is set; the list is still answered so the
interface can explain why downloads are refused.

delete.description:
Delete an installed or enabled model's files and answer its `not_installed` state.

Refused with `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND`, `409 MODEL_STATE_CONFLICT` from any other state and
`409 MODEL_IN_USE` while a generation runs. Works under the kill switch.

get.description: Read one model's state and download progress; `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown id.

post.description:
Cancel a download or its verification, delete the files and answer the model's state.

The model returns to `not_installed`. Refused with `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND` and
`409 MODEL_STATE_CONFLICT` when nothing is in progress.

Disable an enabled model, keeping its files, and answer its `installed` state.

Refused with `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND` and `409 MODEL_STATE_CONFLICT` unless it is `enabled`.
Works under the kill switch.

Start or resume the download of a pinned model and answer its `downloading` state.

Refused with `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND`, `403 LOCAL_GENERATION_DISABLED` (kill switch),
`409 MODEL_STATE_CONFLICT` unless the model is not installed or failed, and
`507 INSUFFICIENT_DISK_SPACE`. The transfer runs in the background; poll `GET /models/{id}`.

Enable an installed model and answer its `enabled` state.

Refused with `404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND`, `403 LOCAL_GENERATION_DISABLED` (kill switch) and
`409 MODEL_STATE_CONFLICT` unless the model is `installed`.

get.description: List all projects newest first for the local dashboard.

post.description: Create project metadata and its isolated workspace as one recoverable operation.

delete.description: Stage project files before database deletion so failures remain recoverable.

get.description: Load one persisted project so feature routes recover correctly after refresh.

patch.description: Apply only supplied editable metadata while preserving source evidence.

Return immutable export history newest first for progress and download UI.

post.description: Persist an immutable export request before queueing local ZIP generation.

Persist a queued processing job before handing it to the local Celery worker.

The optional body carries the project type and spoken language chosen in the Process dialog.
A project without a type (for example a recording) is refused with `PROJECT_TYPE_REQUIRED`
unless the body supplies one.

schema.title: Response List Screenshots Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Screenshots Get

get.description: Return active transcript segments in stable review order.

schema.title: Response List Segments Api V1 Projects  Project Id  Segments Get

delete.description:
Delete the original recording once a package of the current review exists.

Answers the project's refreshed storage figures. Refused with `PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (409) before
an export, `PROJECT_BUSY` while background work runs and `SOURCE_VIDEO_REMOVED` (409) when
it is already gone. Existing packages are untouched.

get.description: Serve the validated source with single-byte-range support for native seeking.

post.description: Stream multipart bytes directly to project storage and promote one valid video.

Create a project and its open recording session with one chunk folder per track.

The project has no source video until the session is completed (P05.2) and no project type
until the user chooses one when processing starts (P05.4).

delete.description:
Discard an open session: delete its chunks, its rows and the project made for it.

A saved (completed) recording is refused with `INVALID_PROJECT_STATE`; delete its project
instead.

get.description: Read the session state and what each track has stored, so a recorder can resume.

post.description:
Save an open recording as its project's source video and return the project.

Joins each track's chunks, aligns the microphone by the stored start offsets, mixes it into
the system audio, validates the result like an uploaded video and keeps the aligned
microphone as `source/microphone.webm`. The project becomes `uploaded`; no processing job is
queued. Errors are listed in `complete_recording`; a busy project answers `PROJECT_BUSY`.

409.description: Missing chunks, busy or saved recording

put.description:
Store one chunk of `screen` or `microphone` atomically; an identical repeat returns 200.

Chunks of both tracks and of any sequence order may arrive concurrently; they do not take
the project operation reservation, which would serialize the two tracks.

413.description: Chunk or session above its limit

get.description: Serve one project-owned screenshot from safe local storage.
Serve or lazily create one lightweight project-owned review thumbnail.

post.description: Merge an ordered contiguous selection and retain source lineage.

get.description: Load one transcript segment for direct review links and API clients.

patch.description:
Save reviewed text and/or the speaker label while never modifying raw transcript evidence.

Either field can be sent alone; `speakerLabel: null` clears the label. Raises 404 for an
unknown segment, 409 for an archived segment or a busy project, and 422 for an empty body or
a label other than `you` / `others`.

put.description: Select one same-project candidate as the segment's explicit primary evidence.
